name: Younghoon
bio: Kim Young-hoon (김영훈; born August 8, 1997), known mononymously as Younghoon (영훈), is a South Korean singer-songwriter and actor under One Hundred Label. He is a member of the boy group THE BOYZ.

credits.title: Wi-Fi Love in the Palace
credits.overview: A time travel romance across past and present, about a webtoon artist desperate for a hit and a palace maid who wants to become a royal concubine, connected by a mysterious cabinet.
